thread:
amanda: Kicking off PROD deploy window for release 2024.01.11. Will enable feature flag `adaptive-routing-v2` as telemetry-gated ramp. Starting at 2% traffic.
deploy-bot: deploy-start acknowledged for release 2024.01.11 by amanda. toggling `adaptive-routing-v2` -> 2% (cohort ids: A100..A199). Watchers: jason, sasha, li.
li: heads-up — infra autoscale looks healthy but keep an eye on regional queues in eu-west.
jason: dashboards up: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/adaptive-routing — watching p95, error_rate, retry_count.
sasha: running health checks now, will post if any anomalies. plan: 2% -> 10% after 5m if error_rate < 0.3% and p95 delta < 15ms.
ops-bot: note: blackout window ends 02:00 UTC, we have 90m margin. No high-priority DB migrations in this window.
deploy-bot: metrics snapshot (2m): error_rate=0.08%, p95_delta=+4ms, route_retries=3. infra_cpu=32%.
amanda: good. proceed to 10% in 5m unless anyone shouts.
li: approve.
rachel: quick FYI — I see a slight bump in reroute-fail count in ap-southeast. It's small but tracked. I'll watch.
sasha: bump observed in ap-southeast: reroute_fail +0.6 over baseline (relative +60%). rolling threshold is 0.5% absolute. holding ramp.
deploy-bot: automatic-hold triggered: `adaptive-routing-v2` ramp paused at 2% due to telemetry gate breach (reroute_fail > threshold). collecting logs.
amanda: OK pause. snapshotting current: tagging release with holdpoint. linking release notes draft: https://confluence.redwood/release/2024.01.11/draft
jason: digging into traces — looks like an edge case with legacy session cookies and one routing backend returning 502. I'll open a quick fix and a follow-up patch.
sasha: can we pin that region out of cohort while we patch? suggestion: reduce ap-southeast weight to 0% and keep other regions at 2%.
li: we can do that without full rollback. set region override via `ffctl set adaptive-routing-v2 ap-southeast=0` — go ahead.
deploy-bot: region override applied: ap-southeast=0, global cohort remains 2% (cohorts: A100..A199 except ap-southeast buckets). telemetry continues to stream.
ops-bot: FYI created incident-2345 for the ap-southeast routing backend (link: https://incidents.redwood/2345). Oncall alerted.
amanda: decision: hold global ramp. no further increase until patch and 30m soak with ap-southeast excluded. if patch ready earlier we can resume a targeted 5% ramp.
rachel: adding note to release notes and to postmortem template.
amanda: thanks team. follow-up owners: jason (fix), sasha (soak + verification), li (rollback plan if fix fails). I'll update the release channel after fix verification. :thumbsup:
